heroText: Choose the level of privacy you need according to your needs. Everything at your fingertips in a simple and elegant way.
featureText1: Functional and switchable dimming film for liquid crystal display that uses polymer dispersed liquid crystal (PDLC) as the display structure.
featureText2: Ideal for offices, residences, hotels, public, display.
featureCard1Text: When electricity is applied to the film through wiring, the liquid crystals align and the window becomes instantly transparent. When the power is turned off, the liquid crystals return to their normal scattered positions, making the glass opaque.
featureCard2Text1: Privacy protection and room partitioning, blocking sun rays, 99% UV, 98% IR rays.
featureCard2Text2: Protecting your interiors from fading and yellowing, seeking to protect people from diseases caused by direct sunlight.
featureCard2Text3: Sound insulation: can block 20% more noise than normal glass. The warranty is 2 years and the estimated lifespan is over 10 years.
featureCard3Text1: Multiple control such as wall switch, sensors, remote control, voice control, app, home automation, etc.
featureCard3Text2: Easy to design, install and configure.
